summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements in responsible AI governance, AI-powered workforce transformation, and robotics. OpenAI and Anthropic are making strides in AI safety and security, while Google DeepMind is pushing the boundaries of robotics and AI model control. Meanwhile, Meta is investing heavily in personal AI agents, and Microsoft is working on an AI 'super app'.
insight: The increasing focus on responsible AI governance and safety is driving innovation in the industry, with companies like OpenAI and Anthropic leading the charge. This shift is expected to have a profound impact on the future of AI development and deployment.
highlights: OpenAI shares its safety, security, transparency, and provenance practices to support responsible AI governance in Europe.
Google DeepMind's new AI model can control a robot's entire body, marking a significant breakthrough in robotics.
Meta is investing heavily in personal AI agents, with Mark Zuckerberg predicting that billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years.
